children: Author Sharon Weinberger told Bloomberg This Weekend that Silicon Valley’s relationship with the defense industry has changed as technology companies and investors increasingly embrace national security work.

Speaking with host Christina Ruffini, Weinberger said the growing power of AI and defense technology companies is testing the government’s ability to provide effective regulation and oversight, according to Bloomberg.

title: AI Expands Tech Firms’ National Security Role
